proposed.text: For a rectangular section bent about its strong axis, what moment of inertia I is used for stiffness checks?

options.text: I = b^3 h / 12 for the same strong-axis orientation.

rationale.correct: For the usual strong-axis rectangular beam orientation, I = b h^3 / 12. Section modulus S = b h^2 / 6 is a different property used for stress.
rationale.takeaway: Use I for stiffness and S for bending stress.
